budgets.what: Wear OS cold start: process fork to the first composed frame of the watch home screen.

source.note: 4503 ms measured on the watch at the S3368 pre-handoff run, against the 5292 ms pre-S3368 baseline. The budget is the achieved number, not the old one: a budget set at the number already beaten is the only kind that can detect the regression back to it.
